subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt fix, replace it with a narrow same-repo repair, or pause for a broader prompt-boundary decision?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open closing-syntax fork PR and the existing no-new-fix-pr routing mean automation should not start another repair until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused OpenClaw PR covering custom-prompt mutation plus the transcript-marker boundary.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to resolve conflicts, add real heartbeat proof, and expand tests for the model-visible prompt behavior.

options.title: Pause For Prompt-Boundary Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open while a heartbeat owner decides whether the fix should be limited to the path hint or include broader transcript/runtime-context changes.

recommendation.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused OpenClaw PR covering custom-prompt mutation plus the transcript-marker boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the path-hint commit and the first maintainer fix attempt for the same regression.
